resources.string: Keep the conversation going. Your desktop does the work, wherever you are.
Open Connect phone on your desktop. Use Tailscale for wireless access, or connect with a USB data cable.
Connect a USB data cable and allow USB debugging on this phone. In the desktop app, open Connect phone → USB cable → Connect. Tailscale is not needed.
Check the USB cable and allow USB debugging. Keep VelumCode open on your computer, then choose Connect phone → USB cable → Reconnect.
Remove this desktop and its saved login from this phone? You can also revoke the phone in VelumCode on your desktop.
Enter the private address from VelumCode. Use the full QR link to pair a new phone.
Use a VelumCode HTTPS link ending in .ts.net:8443, or choose Connect by USB. Pair from Connect phone on your desktop.
Scan the QR in VelumCode → Connect phone
Camera access is needed to scan a QR code. You can also enter the desktop link.
Your desktop is out of reach.
Connect Tailscale on this phone and keep your desktop awake with VelumCode running. Then try again.
The desktop certificate could not be verified. Check the date on both devices and your Tailscale HTTPS setup.
This closes your current phone conversation. The work on your desktop keeps running.
No browser is available to open this link.
